t: Arrival Of George Bernard Shaw To Shanghai

pages.en:
February 17, 1933. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

THE VISIT OF MR. BERNARD SHAW.

Mr. George Bernard Shaw, famous Irish wit
and playwright, accompanied by his wife, arrived in Shanghai
at 10.30 a.m. yesterday by the S.S. "Empress of Britain."
A large crowd including Chinese and foreign journalists
and Madame Sun Yat Sen, Dr. Tsai Yuen Pei, Ling Yu Daung
(林语堂) and Yang Hang Ver (杨杏佛), all of whom are
the promoters of the Chinese People's Rights Protection
League, welcomed them. Mr. Shaw accompanied by Madame
Sun immediately proceeded to the latter's residence at
No. 29 Rue Moliere, French Concession. Later Mr. Shaw
called on Dr. Tsai Yuen Pei and attended a tiffin at noon
given by Madame Sun Yat Sen in his honor.
At 3 p.m. yesterday, Mr. Shaw received
various local journalists and delivered the following
speech:-

"It is difficult to reply to the question
how Eastern oppressed races may find the right course to
follow. When I passed through Hongkong, I exhorted students
to start a revolution, but it should not be misunderstood
that I was urging the students to assault the Police on
the streets. The best policy for the students to adopt
when policemen arrive on the scene to maintain good order
is to run away as fast as they can in order to avoid a
tragedy. The students must not attack the Police because
a policeman like a pistol in the hands of a robber.
Whenever we meet with robbers, we do not like to resist his
pistol. However if we wish to overthrow the holder of the
pistol, schemes must be organised. Violence is dangerous.
For instance, workers go on strike because they had failed
to get better treatment and as a result they will be hungry
and cold. On the basis of socialism, I am opposed to
strikes, but owing to existing conditions, a strike may be
the only effective measure.

"During the past few years, Soviet Russia has
perfected her domestic affairs. It is worthy of being
imitated by all nations. I am strongly convinced that
socialism will spread throughout the world sooner or later
notwithstanding the different policies of the old nations.
The success of the Soviet revolution may be regarded as
a consequence of the too cruel treatment of political
offenders by the former Russian Empire, which banished to
Siberia all Russians holding divergent political thoughts.
This gave the determined revolutionists an opportunity to
study the organization of a Soviet Government."

At this time, a Russian reporter, who was
present, said to Mr. Shaw: "When I left Russia, conditions
in the country were extremely confused and it was not so
favourable as you are now praising them."

Mr. Shaw made the following strong reply:-
"That was the condition of Soviet Russia in 1922 when you
left. It is not so to-day. If you return to Russia at
present to make observations, (provided you can again make good
your escape from the country) you will realise the present
excellent position of Soviet Russia. You will never be able
to appreciate the speedy progress being made by Soviet
Russia."

1933年2月17日。晨间译件。

杂项

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

萧伯纳先生来访。

爱尔兰著名幽默作家及剧作家乔治·萧伯纳先生，在其夫人陪同下，于昨日上午10时30分乘“不列颠皇后号”（S.S. "Empress of Britain"）抵达上海。包括中外记者以及宋庆龄女士、蔡元培博士、林语堂和杨杏佛在内的大批人群欢迎了他们，上述人士均为中国人权保障同盟的发起人。萧伯纳先生在宋庆龄女士的陪同下，立即前往其位于法租界莫利爱路29号的寓所。随后，萧伯纳先生拜访了蔡元培博士，并出席了中午由宋庆龄女士为其举办的便宴。

昨日下午3时，萧伯纳先生接见了各位本地记者，并发表了如下演讲：

“对于东方被压迫民族如何找到正确的道路这一问题，很难作答。当我途经香港时，我曾劝勉学生发起革命，但不应误解为我是在鼓动学生在街头袭击警察。当警察到达现场维持秩序时，学生应采取的最佳策略是尽快逃离，以避免悲剧发生。学生切勿攻击警察，因为警察就像强盗手中的手枪一样。每当我们要面对强盗时，我们都不愿抵抗他的手枪。然而，如果我们希望推翻持枪者，就必须组织谋划。暴力是危险的。例如，工人罢工是因为他们未能获得更好的待遇，结果导致他们挨饿受冻。基于社会主义立场，我反对罢工，但由于现有条件，罢工可能是唯一有效的措施。

“在过去几年中，苏维埃俄罗斯完善了其国内事务。值得所有国家效仿。我坚信，尽管旧各国政策各异，社会主义迟早将遍布全世界。苏维埃革命的成功可被视为前俄罗斯帝国对政治犯过于残酷对待的后果，该帝国将所有持有不同政治思想的俄罗斯人流放至西伯利亚。这给坚定的革命者提供了研究苏维埃政府组织的机会。”

此时，在场的一位俄国记者对萧伯纳先生说：“当我离开俄罗斯时，该国局势极其混乱，并不像您现在赞扬的那样有利。”

萧伯纳先生作出了如下强有力的回答：“那是1922年你离开时的苏维埃俄罗斯状况。今天已非如此。如果你现在回到俄罗斯进行观察（假如你能再次成功逃离该国），你会意识到苏维埃俄罗斯目前的极佳状况。你将永远无法领会苏维埃俄罗斯正在取得的迅速进步。”

Chinese practical Dramatic Society & Dr. G. Bernard Shaw

It is learned that the China Practical Dramatic Society
proposed to produce Dr. G. Bernard Shaw's dramatic plays and welcome
him to China, but this failed to materialize owing to lack of time.
It is reported that the play "The Roaring China" is under preparation
and will be given by the Shanghai Students Federation in support
of the North-Eastern Volunteer Armies.

Dr. G. Bernard Shaw's events

Dr. G. Bernard Shaw has made himself renowned by his discursive
literature. The first sentence he pronounced in a sound film
taken at a welcome meeting in Moscow was "Gentlemen Majesty".
He later explained that there were still certain "majesties" in
the world willing to attend his lectures.
It is said that a certain actress in London who is
renowned for her beauty had told Dr. G. Bernard Shaw as follows:
"I wish to be married to you and give birth to a child whose
face will look like mine but whose brain will be like yours.
He will be the most beautiful and most intelligent human being in
the world". Dr. Shaw replied "What will happen if the contrary
takes place?". Let us see his counter-attack!

中国实践戏剧社与G. 萧伯纳博士

据悉，中国实践戏剧社曾提议上演G. 萧伯纳博士的戏剧作品并欢迎他来华，但因时间不足而未果。据报道，《怒吼吧，中国》一剧正在筹备中，将由上海学生联合会演出，以支持东北义勇军。

G. 萧伯纳博士之轶事

G. 萧伯纳博士以其漫谈式文学闻名。他在莫斯科一次欢迎会上拍摄的有声电影中说的第一句话是“诸位陛下”。他后来解释说，世界上仍有一些“陛下”愿意聆听他的演讲。
据说伦敦一位以美貌著称的女演员曾对G. 萧伯纳博士说：“我希望嫁给你，生下一个面容像我但头脑像你的孩子。他将成为世界上最美丽、最聪明的人。”萧伯纳博士回答说：“如果情况相反怎么办？”让我们看看他的反击！

Pamphlet on of : manifesto issue by students of various
universities and middle schools to welcome Dr. G. Bernard
Shaw, which was obtained by the Municipal Police at the
Customs Jetty, The Bund, on February 17, 1933.
----------

Gentlemen :

While the Japanese imperialists are seriously
attacking in the North East and the international
imperialists are considering taking over the joint
control of China, Dr. G. Bernard Shaw, a great world
author and one of the leaders of the opposition to the
imperialist campaign and massacre, is about to arrive.
This is great news. You should prepare to welcome his
arrival. (Slogans in English embodied in the pamphlet)

Welcome George Bernard Shaw !

Welcome Shaw - The red color artist !

Welcome Shaw - the remarkable dramatist !

Welcome Shaw - the star of peace !

Welcome Shaw - the sympathiser of complement
of Chinese territory !

Welcome Shaw - the sympathiser of independence
and freedom of China !

Welcome Shaw, down with imperialism !

Welcome Shaw, oppose Japanese new invasion !

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. Bk. No REGISTRY. No. D 11498 S. 2. Serious Date 17/2/33）

Subject (in full) Arrival of George Bernard Shaw.

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by J.B. Ru. O.I.

In accordance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch a surveillance was kept on the crowd assembled
in the vicinity of the Customs pontoon for the purpose of
greeting Mr Shaw on his arrival.

Except for representatives of the Press there were no
"White" Russians present. The latter appear to be taking
little, if any, interest in the movements of Mr Shaw.

Among the crowd on the pontoon was a party of Chinese
students, some of whom were supporting a banner on which was
inscribed : "Welcome to George Bernard Shaw. Down with Imperialism".
Others were distributing pamphlets. On examination these were
found to have no connection with communism. Therefore, beyond
keeping a watch on the persons distributing the leaflets, lest
communist matter should be slipped around, no notice was
taken of the matter.

I attach copies of the different pamphlets in
circulation, together with translation of same.

The crowd dispersed towards noon, when it was learned that
the writer had come ashore at Woosung.

Translation of a handbill entitled "Yeu Ayi (遊藝) Special Issue",
Special Issue to Welcome Dr.G. Bernard Shaw, issue no.2, dated
February 15,1933, purporting to emanate from the Propaganda
Department of ---- (organization not mentioned), which was obtained
by the Municipal Police at the Customs Jetty, The Bund, on February
17,1933.

Dr.G.Bernard Shaw & the "World Anti-Imperialist League"

Dr.G.Bernard Shaw, famous modern writer, was one of the
four great authors in Great Britain before the European War. This
is well known to the public. Translations of a number of his
articles have been made in China. He is a reformed socialist
and a member of the Anti-Imperialist League which makes
no distinction of the nationality of its members. The membership
consists of scientists such as Einstein, writers Barbusse,
Romain Rolland (?), Gorki, Jankinsky (?), philosophers Douwei (?),
Rousseau, etc. Madame Sun Yat sen is one of the presidium
of this League. The Eastern Inspection Group to be headed
by Barbusse will soon arrive here (probably at the end of March)
which is greatly different in nature from the Inquiry Commission
of the League of Nations headed by Lytton. The former is anti-
Imperialist while the latter is 100% imperialistic. Dr.G.Bernard
Shaw is the fore-runner of the Anti-Imperialist Inspection Group.

Dr.G.Bernard Shaw & the League of Nations

Dr.G.Bernard Shaw told a foreigner reporter in Hongkong "
The Secretariat of the League of Nations has been overthrown by
Japan; the League no longer exists". However, certain people
in China still hope that the League will uphold justice and
in consequence place their confidence thereon. This is
absolutely foolish, or they are crazy. Such people are crazy

Dr.G.Bernard Shaw & the Soviet Union

Who does not know that Dr.G.Bernard Shaw has visited the
Soviet Union? He spoke the truth with the result that he was
branded as "crazy" by the capitalists. When he arrived in
Hongkong, he still advised capitalistic nations to study the
Soviet Union because there are many good points in the Soviet
system. How will all the youths feel upon hearing this
from Dr.G.Bernard Shaw?

Chinan Practical Dramatic Society & Dr.G.Bernard Shaw

It is learned that the Chinan Practical Dramatic Society
proposed to produce Dr.G.Bernard Shaw's dramatic plays and welcome
him to China, but this failed to materialize owing to lack of time.
It is reported that the play "The Roaring China" is under preparation
and will be given by the Shanghai Students Federation in support
of the North-Eastern Volunteer Armies.

Dr.G.Bernard Shaw's events

Dr.G.Bernard Shaw has made himself renowned by his discursive
literature. The first sentence he pronounced in a sound film
taken at a welcome meeting in Moscow was "Gentlemen Majesty".
He later explained that there were still certain "majesties" in
the world willing to attend his lectures.
It is said that a certain actress in London who is
renowned for her beauty had told Dr.G.Bernard Shaw as follows:
"I wish to be married to you and give birth to a child whose
face will look like mine but whose brain will be like yours.
He will be the most beautiful and most intelligent human being in
the world". Dr.Shaw replied "What will happen if the contrary
takes place?". Let us see his countenance!

题为《游艺特刊》的传单译文，
欢迎萧伯纳博士特刊，第2期，日期为
1933年2月15日，声称由----（未提及组织名称）宣传部
发出，该传单于1933年2月17日由工部局警务处
在外滩海关码头查获。

萧伯纳博士与“世界反帝同盟”

萧伯纳博士，著名现代作家，是欧战前
英国四大作家之一。这为公众所熟知。他的
许多文章已被译成中文。他是一位改良派社会主义者，
也是反帝同盟的成员，该同盟不分成员国籍。其成员
包括科学家如爱因斯坦，作家巴比塞、
罗曼·罗兰（?）、高尔基、扬金斯基（?），哲学家杜威（?）、
卢梭等。孙逸仙夫人是该同盟主席团成员之一。
由巴比塞率领的东方视察团即将抵达此地
（可能在三月底），这与由李顿率领的国际联盟
调查委员会性质截然不同。前者是反
帝国主义的，而后者则是100%帝国主义的。萧伯纳
博士是反帝视察团的先驱。

萧伯纳博士与国际联盟

萧伯纳博士在香港对一名外国记者说：“
国际联盟秘书处已被日本推翻；国联已不复存在”。然而，中国
某些人仍希望国联能主持公道，
并因此对其寄予信任。这
绝对是愚蠢的，或者他们是疯了。这些人真是疯了

萧伯纳博士与苏联

谁不知道萧伯纳博士曾访问过
苏联？他讲了真话，结果被资本家
贴上“疯子”的标签。当他抵达
香港时，他仍建议资本主义国家研究
苏联，因为苏联制度有许多优点。青年们
听到萧伯纳博士这番话会有何感想？

中华实践剧社与萧伯纳博士

据悉，中华实践剧社
曾提议上演萧伯纳博士的戏剧并欢迎
他来华，但因时间不足未能实现。
据报道，《怒吼吧，中国》一剧正在筹备中，
将由上海学生联合会演出，以支持
东北义勇军。

萧伯纳博士轶事

萧伯纳博士以其漫谈式文学闻名。他在
莫斯科一次欢迎会上拍摄的一部有声电影中
说的第一句话是“诸位陛下”。
他后来解释说，世界上仍有某些“陛下”
愿意出席他的讲座。
据说伦敦有一位以美貌著称的女演员
曾对萧伯纳博士说：
“我希望嫁给你，生一个孩子，他的
脸像我，但头脑像你。
他将是世界上最美丽、最聪明的人”。萧博士
回答说：“如果情况相反怎么办？”。让我们看看
他的面容！

Gentlemen :

While the Japanese imperialists are seriously
attacking in the North East and the International
imperialists are considering taking over the joint
control of China, Dr. G. Bernard Shaw, a great world
author and one of the leaders of the opposition to the
imperialistic campaign and massacre, is about to arrive.
This is great news. You should prepare to welcome his
arrival. (Slogans in English embodied in the pamphlet)

Welcome George Bernard Shaw !

Welcome Shaw - The radical artist !

Welcome Shaw - the remarkable dramatist !

Welcome Shaw - the star of peace !

Welcome Shaw - the sympathiser of complement
of Chinese territory !

Welcome Shaw - the sympathiser of independence
and freedom of China !

Welcome Shaw, down with imperialism !

Welcome Shaw, oppose Japanese new invasion !

Translation of a handbill entitled "Manifesto issued by the
Theatrical Performances Meeting held by the Dramatic Societies
of Shanghai Students to Support the North Eastern Volunteer
Armies and to Demand the National Government to Despatch
800,000 soldiers to restore the lost territory" which was
obtained by the Municipal Police at the Customs Jetty, The
Bund, on February 17, 1933.
----------

To all brethren throughout the country,

    Thousands and thousands of our brethren have been
massacred and their property ruined since the Japanese forces
have occupied the North-East and created a conflict in
Woosung and Shanghai. The ambition of the brutal Japanese
is not yet satisfied. They have occupied Yukwan; Jehol,
Peiping and Tientsin are also being menaced. Every
citizen is saddened on learning these reports. We are
deeply moved by the national crisis and therefore request
the Government to despatch 800,000 soldiers to proceed to
the North-East to restore the lost territory and to
annihilate the enemies. We hope that all brethren through-
the country
out/will support us in our endeavours to obtain this end.

THE CHINA PRESS. SUNDAY, JANUARY 29, 1933

G.B.S. Issues Pro-Soviet
Anti-Capitalist Manifesto

Dramatist, Now On Way To Shanghai, Points
To Plight Of England And Progress In USSR

LONDON, Jan. 28.—(Tass)—A striking manifesto has been published here over the name of Mr. George Bernard Shaw, the famous dramatist who is now touring the Far East as a passenger aboard the tourist ship, "Empress of Britain." Mr. Shaw is due in Shanghai Feb. 17.

Mr. Shaw's manifesto concerns itself with the world economic crisis and its devastating effects in the countries of capitalism. Pointing out that unemployment continues to grow in all the countries of the capitalist world and that capitalism has proven incapable of coping with it, Mr. Shaw urges all classes and parties to make a careful comparison of the sorry conditions in England with the striking achievements of the U.S.S.R.

Deriding the current accusations against the U.S.S.R. in regard to "Soviet propaganda," Mr. Shaw says there is no proof that the Soviet Government has either the time or the inclination to promote any propaganda other than the tremendous propaganda represented by its very existence and activity.

The co-signatories of the manifesto, Mr. Shaw points out, have all, like himself, recently visited the U.S.S.R. There they saw no such economic slavery, such widespread unemployment and depths of privation and despair as they encountered in their own country. In the U.S.S.R. they witnessed the tremendous enthusiasm and confidence of the Russian workers who were conducting a heroic struggle with the terrible heritage of the past. Everywhere in the U.S.S.R. there was extensive public construction, advancement of education and public health. Woman had been emancipated and children were properly cared for.

In conclusion, Mr. Shaw calls for aid for the movement promoting peaceful relations with the U.S.S.R. and for close friendship between the workers of Britain and the U.S.S.R.

《字林西报》。1933年1月29日，星期日

萧伯纳发表亲苏
反资本主义宣言

剧作家在赴沪途中指出
英国的困境与苏联的进步

伦敦，1月28日.—(塔斯社)—这里发表了一份引人注目的宣言，署名者为著名剧作家乔治·萧伯纳先生，他目前正作为游客乘坐“不列颠皇后”号游轮巡游远东。萧伯纳先生定于2月17日抵达上海。

萧伯纳先生的宣言关注世界经济危机及其对资本主义国家的破坏性影响。萧伯纳指出，资本主义世界所有国家的失业人数持续增长，且资本主义已被证明无力应对这一问题，他敦促各阶层和政党仔细比较英国的悲惨状况与苏联取得的显著成就。

萧伯纳嘲笑当前针对苏联的所谓“苏维埃宣传”的指控，他说，没有证据表明苏联政府有时间或意愿去推动除其存在和活动本身所代表的巨大宣传之外的任何宣传。

萧伯纳指出，宣言的共同签署者都像他一样，最近访问了苏联。在那里，他们没有看到像在自己国家遇到的那种经济奴役、广泛失业以及贫困和绝望的深度。在苏联，他们目睹了俄罗斯工人巨大的热情和信心，他们正在与可怕的过去遗产进行英勇斗争。苏联各地都在进行大规模的公共建设，推进教育和公共卫生。妇女获得了解放，儿童得到了妥善照顾。

最后，萧伯纳呼吁援助促进与苏联和平关系的运动，并促进英国工人与苏联工人之间的密切友谊。
